title: Flutter Developer
description:
**Job Description** – Flutter Developer

**Company**: GCC Dynamics

**Location**: Kochi, Kerala

**Job Title:** Flutter Developer

**Experience**: 1–2 Years

**Working Days**: Monday to Saturday

**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 5:30 PM

**About the Company**

GCC Dynamics is looking for a skilled and motivated Flutter Developer to join our development team in Kochi. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in mobile application development and be capable of independently handling development tasks and delivering high-quality applications for Android and iOS platforms.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a Flutter Developer with strong technical knowledge of Flutter and Dart, experience in BLoC state management, Firebase integration, and REST API development. The candidate should be comfortable developing, debugging, maintaining, and deploying mobile applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop, maintain, and optimize mobile applications for Android and iOS using Flutter.

- Integrate REST APIs and Firebase services into mobile applications.

- Implement effective state management using BLoC.

- Write clean, reusable, efficient, and maintainable code.

- Identify and troubleshoot bugs and improve application performance.

- Handle application testing, debugging, builds, and deployment.

- Manage iOS configurations, certificates, provisioning profiles, and App Store submissions.

- Collaborate with team members to understand project requirements and deliver solutions on time.

- Use Git for version control and collaborative development.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

- 1–2 years of hands-on experience in Flutter development.

- Strong proficiency in Flutter and Dart.

- Experience with BLoC state management.

- Hands-on experience with Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), and Crashlytics.

- Experience integrating REST APIs using Dio or HTTP.

- Knowledge of Android and iOS application development and deployment.

- Familiarity with Xcode, iOS certificates, provisioning profiles, and App Store submission.

- Experience using Git and version control systems.

- Understanding of responsive UI design, debugging, and performance optimization.

- Knowledge of local storage solutions such as Hive and SharedPreferences.

**Work Details**

- Company: GCC Dynamics

- Location: Kochi, Kerala

- Working Days: Monday to Saturday

- Working Hours: 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to contact us for further details and application procedures.

**Contact Numbers:** 6235340082, 7034375558

Join GCC Dynamics and contribute to developing reliable, high-performance mobile applications

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
description:
**Mobile Application Developer Intern**

Company: Codebxo Solution

Location: Remote or Onsite – Kochi, Kerala

Internship Duration: 6 Months

Employment Type: Full-Time Internship

Future Opportunity: Potential full-time employment based on performance

**About Codebxo Solution**

Codebxo Solution is a Saudi Arabia-based software company with an office in Kochi, India. We work on internal products and client projects, building software solutions that address real-world business needs.

We are looking for a motivated Mobile Application Developer Intern who is eager to learn, build practical skills, and contribute to real-world applications under the guidance of experienced developers.

**Role Overview**

As a Mobile Application Developer Intern, you will learn how mobile applications are designed, developed, tested, and connected to backend services. You will initially become familiar with our development practices and gradually take on more responsibility as your skills improve.

We value strong programming fundamentals, problem-solving ability, consistency, and a willingness to learn over experience with every technology in our stack.

**What You'll Work On**

- Develop and enhance mobile applications using React Native or Flutter.

- Build user-friendly mobile interfaces and reusable UI components.

- Integrate REST APIs and connect mobile applications with backend services.

- Implement application features such as authentication, navigation, and data handling.

- Work with databases and backend services where required.

- Debug issues, investigate errors, and improve application performance.

- Test applications across devices and resolve reported issues.

- Collaborate with developers on code reviews, documentation, and feature development.

- Learn and follow good coding practices and version control workflows.

- Contribute to improving application usability, reliability, and maintainability.

**Technical Skills**

***Core Requirements***

- Good programming fundamentals and problem-solving skills.

- Familiarity with React Native or Flutter, or a strong willingness to learn one of them.

- Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript for React Native, or Dart for Flutter.

- Understanding of basic mobile application concepts and UI development.

- Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and JSON.

- Familiarity with Git and GitHub, or willingness to learn.

- Ability to debug problems, research solutions, and ask clear technical questions.

- Willingness to use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support learning and productivity.

**Good to Have**

***Mobile Application Development***

- Experience with state management, such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Provider, or Riverpod.

- Familiarity with mobile navigation, reusable components, and responsive layouts.

- Basic knowledge of application testing and debugging.

- Familiarity with Android Studio, mobile emulators, and device testing.

***Backend and Database***

- Experience with Firebase Authentication or other Firebase services.

- Basic knowledge of PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

- Exposure to backend development using NestJS or Node.js.

- Understanding of authentication, API error handling, and data handling.

***Cloud and Deployment***

- Basic understanding of cloud platforms and application deployment.

- Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Vercel.

- Familiarity with environment variables and API configuration.

- Exposure to Next.js or web application development.

Candidates do not need to know every technology listed above. A strong foundation in one mobile development framework and the willingness to learn are important.

**Who Can Apply?**

- Final-year students or recent graduates in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Freshers with no prior professional experience.

- Candidates who have built academic projects, personal applications, or prototypes are encouraged to apply.

- Applicants must have their own laptop.

- Good communication skills in English and Malayalam are preferred.

**What We Expect**

- A learn, apply, and improve mindset.

- Consistent progress throughout the internship.

- The ability to understand a task and attempt a solution before escalating it.

- Openness to feedback and willingness to improve code quality.

- Responsibility, professionalism, and effective collaboration.

- Interest in learning new tools and applying them to practical problems.

- Willingness to understand existing code and follow established development practices.

**What You'll Gain**

- Hands-on experience with real-world internal and client projects.

- Guidance and feedback from experienced developers.

- Practical exposure to mobile development, APIs, databases, and software engineering workflows.

- Opportunities to strengthen your portfolio and technical skills.

- Experience collaborating with a development team and contributing to real applications.

- Consideration for a full-time position based on your overall performance and the company's requirements.

**Internship Details**

- Duration: 6 months.

- Work mode: Remote or onsite at our Kochi office.

- Working hours: Full-time.

- Stipend: A modest, performance-based stipend, with the amount determined through evaluation and communicated during the selection process.

- Full-time conversion: Successful interns may be considered for full-time employment based on their overall evaluation, technical growth, consistency, and company requirements.

Please note that full-time employment is not guaranteed upon completion of the internship.

**Selection Process**

1. Resume screening.

2. Technical interview covering programming fundamentals and relevant mobile development concepts.

3. Practical coding or development task.

4. Final evaluation based on technical ability, learning mindset, and role suitability.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply by contacting us at **+91 751 084 8406**

Please include your resume and, if available, links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or mobile application projects.

Join Codebxo Solution to learn by building, contribute to real projects, and grow your career in mobile application development.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Mobile App Developer
description:
**Job Title:** Mobile App Developer (Ionic / Angular / Node.js)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 2+ Years  
**Shift Schedule:** Night Shift (6:00 PM – 3:00 AM)  
**Location:** Kochi

**About the Role** We are seeking a talented Mobile App Developer with 2+ years of experience to join our team. In this full-stack role, you will develop, maintain, and scale responsive cross-platform mobile applications. You will take ownership of the complete application lifecycle—from requirement analysis and UI development to API integration, database optimization, and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Mobile & Frontend:** Develop and enhance cross-platform mobile applications using Ionic and Angular. Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces for Android and iOS.
* **Backend Services:** Build, maintain, and secure backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js.
* **Database Management:** Design, optimize, and troubleshoot database queries, functions, and stored procedures using SQL and PostgreSQL.
* **Integration & Security:** Integrate third-party APIs, implement secure communication (JWT/OAuth), and handle application state, error handling, and offline scenarios.
* **Quality Assurance:** Write clean, modular code, perform unit testing, troubleshoot production issues, and collaborate closely with QA and UI/UX teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 2+ years of professional software development experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* **Frontend/Mobile:** Strong proficiency in Ionic Framework, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* **Backend:** Hands-on experience with Node.js, REST API development, and secure authentication methods.
* **Database:** Deep knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL, including complex queries, joins, and performance optimization.
* **Development Practices:** Familiarity with Git, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and the standard SDLC.

**Bonus Points (Good to Have)**

* Experience with Capacitor/Cordova and Android Studio.
* Track record of publishing apps to the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
* Familiarity with push notifications, Firebase (FCM), and application performance monitoring tools.

**How to Apply** Please submit your updated resume along with links to any relevant portfolio projects or apps you have published.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹750,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
